text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the tryouts—a multitude of
races highlighting
up-and-coming runners.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to be late, I make my way
through the academy grounds,
heading
straight for the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah! You there! Yes, you. Could you help
me with a tiny little favor?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup. If anyone comes by asking
questions, just tell them,
"Nature? Nope,
haven't seen her!" and send them on
their—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Natie! She's here—we finally found
her!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Woman

text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What, so you were here the whole time?
You weren't at the track, so
we thought
you mighta overslept or summat.
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text: Uh, just for the record, I'm not that laid-back. If anything, I've been getting up earlier and earlier lately.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you should hear yourself, Natie! You
sounded just like us old
folks there!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Woman

text_block_list.text:
More importantly—the tryouts! We're all
here to cheer you on, so go
get 'em, Natie!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Woman

text_block_list.text:
Um, I appreciate all of you coming out
here... But don't get your
hopes up too
much, 'kay?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I know my name makes me sound like a
natural winner, but to be
honest, my
talents really aren't all that.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Like, the best I placed in my scrimmages
was third. And it's not like
I've got any
grand ol' dreams either.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't say that. Well, we gotta
get ready too. Make sure ya
warm those
muscles up, Natie!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Man

text_block_list.text: Haha... Yeah, 'preciate it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Hey, so um, sorry about that. Totally left
you hanging there.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Were those people part of your fan club or
something?

text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's nothing like that. They're just
some folks from the local
shopping district
who're here to support me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's just, I can't really live up to their
expectations, so I wanted to
avoid them if
I could.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
By the way... Hm? That badge on your
collar...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wait, are you a trainer here?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! Yikes, then I totally flubbed my elevator pitch! Even if I did say nothing but the gospel truth...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Um, haha... Hey, the name's Nature. I'm
running in today's tryouts, so
guess you'll
be seeing me kinda...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Anyways, catcha 'round.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The strangely cynical Найс Нэйчер
promptly dashes away in the
direction of
the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And now, the tryouts begin!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... All right, first place!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
S-simply immaculate! Such beautiful and
refined running, Токай Тэйо!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Looks like the rumors about her being the
second coming of Symboli
Rudolf were
true! Teio, please let me scout you!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, wait your turn! Line up before
me, okay? ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
As the races go on, promising racers are
scouted one after another by
the watching
trainers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Man, that's Teio for you. Always stealing
the show...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's got the talent, the skill, and the
looks. And on top of that, she's
got her
big dream of following in Rudolf's
footsteps.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Man, she radiates main character vibes.
We might as well be living in
different
worlds.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Girls like her... really are something else.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер! Please get ready for your
race!
text_block_list.name: Tryouts Official A

text_block_list.text: Right, roger that. Well, time for my turn!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Bang!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Natieeeee! Yeah, just like that! You go,
Natieee!
text_block_list.name: Friendly Supporters

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They're rounding the fourth turn and
entering the final stretch! Can
our
front-runner maintain her position?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
But look at who's giving chase—it's Nice
Nature! Найс Нэйчер has
closed the gap in
an instant!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
My eyes are glued to her amazing running
form. What a clean rush in
the final spurt!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Aaand—it's too little, too late! Nice
Nature, finishing in third place!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew. Well, that's just how it goes.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Even when I go all-out... third's all I get.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Her results might've been unfortunate, but
her running back there was

picture-perfect. Now's my chance!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Ah. Someone's a bit of a ditz,
huh? Teio's line is thataway,
'kay?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: H-huuuuuh?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But like, um... Oh, I'm not saying no, okay?
If anything, thanks for
picking me and all
that.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's just, well... You sure you want me? I
guess if you get fed up with
me... just tell
me, all right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Still, until then... At least for now... I-I'm in
your hands.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I excitedly shake the hand of a nonplussed
Найс Нэйчер, sealing the
deal as her new
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
